decision_question: Which fixed planner and generator engine, if any, passes both factual grounding and governed full-autonomy gates for release?

hard_gates.name: combined-factual-and-autonomy
hard_gates.evidence: Autonomy passed 820/820, but factual fully grounded success was 49.0% and claim/citation gates failed.

hard_gates.name: zero-severe-unsupported-release
hard_gates.evidence: No severe unsupported release was observed.

hard_gates.name: combined-factual-and-autonomy
hard_gates.evidence: Best factual score was 50.5%; autonomy missed the exact primary gate by one case.

hard_gates.name: zero-severe-unsupported-release
hard_gates.evidence: No severe unsupported release was observed.

failures.evidence: Every engine had 100 shared HierarchicalRetrievalError outcomes caused by missing active precomputed-retrieval case binding.
All six engines failed the frozen factual grounding, claim, and citation gate set.
Direct DeepSeek E4 produced repeated planner-contract configuration failures and 36.585% safe grounded autonomous success.

decision.rationale: No engine passed the combined factual and autonomy gates. Repair shared retrieval case binding and redesign evidence-to-answer generation on a fresh development tranche; do not rerun this benchmark.

limitations: The common 100-case retrieval integration defect depresses every factual condition, although residual quality remains far below the gate after accounting for it.
Fresh sealed 1,000, known 10,000+1,000, proxy, and release stages were correctly left unopened.
The evaluation uses public-synthetic cases and no independent real professor or student participants.
